_comment: normalizeOllamaName splits a glued family/version Ollama tag, with a SINGLE-LETTER SERIES GUARD. Relaxing the alnum-split pattern from {2,} to + would split deepseek-r1 into deepseek-r-1 and redden the glued rows — which is exactly what those rows exist to catch.

mutation.description: splits a glued multi-digit dotted version
splits a glued dotted version on a different family
splits a glued single-digit version on a three-letter family

provenance.ref: the single-letter series token r1 must NOT be split

mutation.description: shortens the pre-digit token to a SINGLE letter, which the guard must refuse to split

provenance.ref: the single-letter series token k2 must NOT be split

mutation.description: a second single-letter series token, so the guard is not pinned to one family
